violations.text: A chemical spray bottle was observed hanging on the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

The temperature of the freezer bowls used to store cans of whipped cream and cold foam were observed with an ambient temperature of 44-58 degrees. Cans were placed in alternate refrigerators, bowls brought to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized prior to re-freezing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026
Debris was observed on the cheese in the cold drawer. PIC disposed affected cheese and covered container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was 0 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for quaternary ammonium sanitizer is 200 ppm. Staff refilled containers during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

The low boy for RockStar beverages is in poor repair, not maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees F or colder. The lid to the prep unit was observed to be loose. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the coffee tap refrigerator and the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ice machine is scheduled for weekly cleaning today. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026
Facility is lacking drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is utilizing drink cup covers for drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026
The hand-washing sink in the front service area was lacking paper towels. PIC provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/24/2025

The hand-washing sink in the front service area was blocked by an ice bucket. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/24/2025
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Ice scoop was stored on top of a box. Items brought to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/24/2025
Prep unit door gaskets were observed in poor repair. PIC stated a work order is in place. New Violation. Correct By: 03/10/2025
The outside dumpster is not covered. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. New Violation. Correct By: 02/24/2025
The pipes of the walk-in freezer condenser are in poor repair. Inspector observed cracked insulation/pipe and ice accumulation. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2025
The hand-washing sink in the front service area was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2024

Food contact surfaces of the ice machines were observed with an accumulation of biofilm and soil residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machines were taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized, and bagged ice used. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2024
The ice bucket was not stored inverted. Water observed inside ice bucket. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2024

The floors including inside the walk in cooler and freezer have an accumulation of soil residue and/or debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2024
